```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  comment = "#>"
)
with_dt <- requireNamespace("DT", quietly = TRUE)
```

This table is generated from hoopR's own `nba_*()` wrappers for `stats.nba.com`:
each row is an R argument that at least one wrapper sends to the API, with the
query parameter it becomes (`api_name`), the values the API accepts and the
function default. The `functions` column lists the `nba_*()` calls that accept
the parameter, so you can filter it to see every function that takes, say,
`per_mode`. The same table ships with the package as `hoopR::parameter_descriptions`.

```{r eval = with_dt}
DT::datatable(hoopR::parameter_descriptions, options = list(scrollX = TRUE, pageLength = 25), filter = "top", rownames = FALSE)
```

```{r eval = !with_dt}
knitr::kable(hoopR::parameter_descriptions)
```

## **Citation**

To cite the [**`hoopR`**](https://hoopR.sportsdataverse.org/) R package in publications, use:

BibTeX Citation

```bibtex
@misc{hoopr,
  author = {Saiem Gilani},
  title = {hoopR: Access Men’s Basketball Play by Play Data.},
  url = {https://hoopR.sportsdataverse.org/},
  year = {2026}
}
```

## **Related SportsDataverse packages**

-   [**cfbfastR**](https://cfbfastR.sportsdataverse.org/) - college football
-   [**hoopR**](https://hoopR.sportsdataverse.org/) - men's basketball
-   [**wehoop**](https://wehoop.sportsdataverse.org/) - women's basketball

-   [**fastRhockey**](https://fastRhockey.sportsdataverse.org/) - hockey
-   [**oddsapiR**](https://oddsapiR.sportsdataverse.org/) - betting odds
